Module to manage the PCF8574. Allows you to read and write either individual bits, or whole bytes.

Types

Pcf8574 = ref object
  expAdd: uint8
  blockk: I2cInst
  buffer: byte

Consts

p0: byte = 0b00000000000000000000000000000001
p1: byte = 0b00000000000000000000000000000010
p2: byte = 0b00000000000000000000000000000100
p3: byte = 0b00000000000000000000000000001000
p4: byte = 0b00000000000000000000000000010000
p5: byte = 0b00000000000000000000000000100000
p6: byte = 0b00000000000000000000000001000000
p7: byte = 0b00000000000000000000000010000000
pcf8574Ver = "1.3.0"

proc readBit(self: Pcf8574; pin: uint8): bool {....raises: [], tags: [].}
Reads the value of a single bit in the PFC8574 register.

Example:

let bit0 = expander.readBit(p0)
let bit7 = expander.readBit(p7)
Parameters:
  • pin: read the single pin indicated (p0..p7).

Return: bool

proc readByte(self: Pcf8574; data: var array[1, uint8]) {....raises: [], tags: [].}
Read the entry byte present that instant.

Example:

let exp = newExpander(blokk = i2c1, expAdd = 0x20)
var readBuffer = [byte(0)]
exp.readByte(readBuffer)
print("Byte sul Expander: " & $readBuffer & '\n')
Parameters:
  • data: byte array where the value received by the PFC8574 is stored.

proc writeBit(self: Pcf8574; pin: uint8; value: bool) {....raises: [], tags: [].}
Write a single byte on the exit (P0, P1 ..) desired.

Example:

self.readByte(pin=p0, value=on)
Parameters:
  • pin: it is the pin on which you want to write the new value (p0..p7).
  • value: on = set exit high, low = set exit low.
proc writeByte(self: Pcf8574; data: byte) {....raises: [], tags: [].}
Write a whole byte (8 outings) on the PCF8574 register.

Example:

self.writeByte(0xAA)
Parameters:
  • data: it is the Byte you want to write on the register.
